answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated TypeScript types are out of date with the Java API. The regenerated output adds new interfaces (LocalObjectOutput, XtmConnectionOutput, and new fields on edge/node/link types) that were not committed. The job's own message says to regenerate and commit. A re-run on the same commit will fail the same way until the types are regenerated and pushed.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
